description: This file implements the GoalsTab widget for a Flutter fitness application. It provides UI for viewing, creating, and managing user fitness goals, including a form for adding new goals and display cards for existing goals.

classes.name: GoalsTab
classes.description: Main widget displaying user goals and form to add new goals.

classes.name: _GoalsTabState
classes.description: State class managing the stateful GoalsTab widget, including data loading and UI updates.

classes.name: _GoalForm
classes.description: Widget containing a form to create new goals.

classes.name: _GoalFormState
classes.description: State class handling form validation, submission, and input state for _GoalForm.

classes.name: _GoalCard
classes.description: Widget to display individual goal details in a styled card.

methods.name: _labelForType
methods.description: Returns label string for a given GoalType.

methods.name: _validateTarget
methods.description: Validates the target input field for numeric and positivity constraints.

methods.name: _submit
methods.description: Handles form submission to create or update a goal.

methods.name: _title
methods.description: Returns the display title for a goal type.

methods.name: _icon
methods.description: Returns an icon representing the goal type.
